LESSON: PLACES OF WORSHIP

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Worship (Ishwar Bhakti)
Topic 4.2: Places of Worship
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Places of Worship, part of Worship (Ishwar Bhakti) in Grade 5 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What is the importance of features you see while visiting a Sikh Gurdwara?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. visit places of worship to witness activities carried out at different times,

2. make a collage of place of worship in his/her locality,

3. use digital devices to map the Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwaras in Kenya,

4. draw and colour the Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara,

5. discuss practice of ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara,

6. visit a Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara to witness ceremonies, architecture and important features,

7. assist learners with special needs as per their abilities through peer teaching the religious practices carried out in a place of worship.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. visit places of worship to witness activities carried out at different times,
2. make a collage of place of worship in his/her locality,
3. use digital devices to map the Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwaras in Kenya,
4. draw and colour the Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara,
5. discuss practice of ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara,
6. visit a Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara to witness ceremonies, architecture and important features,
7. assist learners with special needs as per their abilities through peer teaching the religious practices carried out in a place of worship.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Places of Worship together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital Literacy: Learner develops digital skills when interacting with technology by using digital devices to

map the Jain temples in Kenya.

Values:
Love: Learner acquires selflessness when visiting a Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara to witness ceremonies,

architecture and important features.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Citizenship: Learner enhances nationalism when participating in ceremonies held in Jain Derasar and Sikh

Gurdwara.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Learner is able to relate the skill of drawing and colouring the Jain Derasar and Sikh Gurdwara to the skills of

drawing and colouring learnt in Creative Arts.
